title: 1996 X-Files Season Two #44 Shadow Paranormals Card
descriptionText: The 1996 X-Files Season Two #44 shadow trading card is a collectible non-sport card manufactured by Topps. This card belongs to the franchise of The X-Files, featuring characters and themes from the popular TV show. Released in 1996, this card is a valuable addition to any trading card collection, especially for fans of the series looking to collect specific cards from that season.
